verdict.rationale: Dover documents point AI features: applicant scoring, AI-generated careers pages and job descriptions, and an AI notetaker. None of these is a built-in assistant that users can hand arbitrary tasks to. These are adjacent features, not the delegation capability the story asks for, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
